children: The Shangai Composite Index dropped 3 points or 0.08 percent on Monday to close at 3885 points.
Losses were led by Avic Shenyang Aircraft (-5.19%), Avic Aviation Engine (-3.36%) and Sinopec (-2.72%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Huayu Automotive (1.84%), Bank of Communications (1.74%) and Sh Fosun Pharma (1.62%).

title: The Shangai Composite Index Closes 0.08% Lower
